cross_component_finding: Capella iQ is the genuinely new territory flagged by this batch's hypothesis, and it does introduce real access-control gating - not just a UI walkthrough. Two distinct role-gated actions are documented: (1) organization-level control (accept terms, choose which model providers are enabled org-wide, turn iQ on/off) gated to Organization Owner - reuses the already-promoted capella-role:organization-owner; and (2) cluster-level model-provider selection gated to either Cluster Manager or Cluster Data Reader/Writer - two roles new to this registry. Notably, the Cluster Data Reader/Writer role's anchor ('cluster-role-cluster-data-reader-writer') is distinct from the already-promoted capella-role:project-data-writer's anchor ('project-cluster-data-reader-writer'), even though both surface as roughly 'Data Reader/Writer' in prose. This suggests Capella's role taxonomy has at least three scopes - organization, project, and cluster - and prior batches (the SQL++ statement reference) only ever surfaced the organization/project scopes gating DDL statements. This batch is the first to surface a cluster-scoped role family, which the coordinator should treat as a new, non-overlapping branch of capella-role:* rather than merging it into the existing project-scoped concepts.
